mainEntity.name: Which AI income stream is best for a beginner: digital products, newsletters, affiliate marketing, or services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose the model that matches an audience you can reach and a problem you understand, rather than selecting the model with the most impressive automation. Digital products may be suitable when you can teach or organize useful information; newsletters depend on consistent publishing and subscriber value; affiliate models require relevant offers and transparent promotion; website services require delivery capacity and client support. Run My AI Biz’s examples show how research, product creation, marketing, and administration can be supported by specialized assistants. Key factors include access to buyers, trust, fulfillment time, recurring costs, and differentiation. Interview potential customers or review real search and community questions before building. Then test a small offer with a clear refund, delivery, and feedback process.
acceptedAnswer.description: There is no universal best option. Choose based on your existing expertise, audience access, delivery workload, trust requirements, and budget. Test a small offer first: a short digital product, focused newsletter, relevant affiliate resource, or narrowly defined service.
